announcements.headline: FY2026 Annual Financial Report
announcements.insight: FY2026 results follow recent commercial terms agreement with Magna and data milestone. Shareholders should watch for financial performance against these developments.

announcements.headline: 3.6 billion kilometres of Guardian data revea...

announcements.insight: Commercial terms agreed with Magna follow the Advanced Robotics Development Contract. A new AGM date is set to formalize these arrangements.

announcements.headline: Q1 FY2027 Quarterly KPIs
announcements.insight: Seeing Machines Ltd. released Q1 FY2027 KPIs, following its August FY2026 update and recent platform launches.

announcements.insight: Seeing Machines launches a technical paper demonstrating real-time 3D human understanding for Physical AI, following its August platform launch.

announcements.insight: The Physical AI platform launch follows the August robotics contract, indicating strategic expansion into advanced robotics.

announcements.insight: Seeing Machines Ltd. secures a new robotics contract, adding to its recent automotive program wins in Japan and Europe.

announcements.insight: Seeing Machines Ltd. provides a trading update following recent program awards and refinancing. Shareholders should monitor execution of these new initiatives.

announcements.insight: This European program award follows recent Japanese OEM wins and a US$31m expansion, indicating continued automotive business growth.

announcements.headline: Convertible Note refinancing update
announcements.insight: Seeing Machines Ltd updates its convertible note refinancing. This follows June programs and a US$31m expansion.

announcements.headline: US$31m expansion on existing Automotive program
announcements.insight: Seeing Machines Ltd secures US$31m expansion for its Automotive program, following earlier wins with Japanese OEMs in June 2026.

announcements.insight: Seeing Machines wins two new Japanese OEM programs. This contract win indicates commercial progress but lacks financial detail for shareholders to assess impact.
